testCase:
H-09: A select that is not a select
Goal: Continue with Portugal as the country.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/h-09/
STEP 2: Choose "Portugal" in "Country"
STEP 3: Click "Continue"
STEP 4: Verify "Country: Portugal" is visible

plan.title: H-09: A select that is not a select

steps.note: Choose Portugal in the country control.
Verify that Portugal was carried through.

reasoning: This test checks that Portugal can be chosen in Country and carried through Continue. The plan uses the select step to handle the country control and verifies the resulting country text.
